import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    a=0.106; b=0.0463; c=0.111
    return (params[0]*np.log(1+a*t)*np.sqrt(P)
            + params[1]*P**2/(1+b*P**2)
            + params[2]*np.exp(-c*P**2)*np.sqrt(t)
            + params[3]*P**2)
